anomaly: Gross DE prints 4.2% of GDP and net DE prints 4.3% — gross share below net share is arithmetically impossible on the same GDP base; the pair appears transposed as printed
proof: 84,012/1,932,291 = 4.35% (rounds 4.3, prints 4.2); 82,275/1,932,291 = 4.26% (rounds 4.3, prints 4.3); identical in the English table (pdf 125, printed 111)
resolution: Kept as printed; DE %GDP shares are not carried in fiscal_outlook_headline.csv, so no data row is affected

location: Jadual 5.3 vs Jadual 5.4, Suria Strategic Energy Resources Sdn. Bhd., Akhir Jun 2025 column
anomaly: The same guarantee position is printed as RM5,005 juta in Jadual 5.3 but RM5,006 juta in Jadual 5.4 - a RM1 juta internal inconsistency between adjacent tables of the same edition
proof: Both readings verified from 150-dpi page renders by the independent adversarial verifier (text layer garbled); J5.3 total 332,819/336,078 and J5.4 total 236,229/237,084 each reconcile only with their own printed cell
resolution: Kept as printed in both rows of fact_contingent_liabilities.csv; consumers comparing the two tables must expect the RM1 juta difference

location: Jadual 3.1, FY2022 column, Bayaran khidmat hutang
anomaly: Domestic debt service printed 40,533 + external 716 = 41,249, under a printed total of 41,269 (RM20 juta short). Printed identically in the 2024 and 2025 editions.
proof: Confirmed on 150-dpi renders of both pages, not only the text layer. Three further lines of evidence that 40,553 is the intended figure: (1) the 2023 edition (Jadual 7.1, jadual_perangkaan.pdf p.56, FY2022 preliminary) printed 40,553 a year earlier; (2) the same row's OWN share column prints 13.9%, which 40,553 gives (40,553 / 292,693 = 13.855%) and 40,533 does not (13.848%, rounds to 13.8); (3) the 2026 edition (st_kewangan.pdf p.5) restates it to 40,553, and 40,553 + 716 = 41,269 exactly. Consistent with a 3/5 transposition carried through two printings.
resolution: Kept as printed in the 2024 and 2025 edition folders. The curated layer takes FY2022 from the 2024 edition (its own edition), so it carries the printed 40,533 -- and says so in the row's note; the other editions' 40,553 is in restated_in and in data/_restatements_editions.csv.
